title: CognitionReport
description: Analysis report output produced by the Mnemosyne cognitive-load analyzer for a single source document.

manifest_version.description: Semantic version of the report manifest format (e.g. "1.0.0").

analyzer_version.description: Semantic version of the Mnemosyne analyzer that produced this report.

source_file.description: Absolute or relative path to the analyzed source file.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file contents, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

document_type.description: Detected or declared format of the source document.

analyzed_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which analysis completed.

global_metrics.description: Aggregate cognitive-load metrics computed across the entire document.

L_txt.description: Textual load score for the document.

L_vis.description: Visual load score for the document.

L_spa.description: Spatial/structural load score for the document.

C_load.description: Composite cognitive load score for the document.

raw_metrics.description: Un-normalized raw metric values before weighting or combination.

friction_index.description: Derived readability friction index in the range [0, 100]. Null when insufficient data is available.

sections.description: Per-section analysis results in document order.

unsupported.description: Metrics that could not be computed for this document, with explanations.

Section.description: Analysis results for a single logical section of the document.

id.description: Unique identifier for this section within the document.

span.description: Character or line offsets delimiting the section within the source.

metrics.description: Cognitive-load metrics scoped to this section.

Issue.description: A single detected readability or structural issue.

confidence.description: Confidence score for this issue detection, in the range [0, 1].

evidence.description: Verbatim excerpts or references from the source that support this issue.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this is considered an issue.

Warning.description: A non-fatal warning emitted by an analysis module.

module.description: Name of the analyzer module that emitted this warning.

UnsupportedMetric.description: A metric that could not be computed for this document.

metric.description: Identifier of the metric that is unsupported.

reason.description: Explanation of why the metric could not be computed.

RefactorGuard.description: Guard configuration that prevents stale reports from being used as refactor inputs.

requires_hash_match.description: When true, the refactorer must verify the source file hash matches source_hash before proceeding.

max_analysis_age_hours.description: Maximum age of this report in hours before it is considered stale for refactoring purposes.
